cards.headline: EFCC secures final forfeiture of $163,592 proceeds of US fraud
cards.what_happened: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has secured a final forfeiture of $163,592 linked to proceeds of fraud committed in the United States. The forfeiture was reported by Premium Times Nigeria. No further details on parties or timing are provided in the available text.
key_facts: EFCC secured a final forfeiture of $163,592.
analysis: Court outcome as reported by Premium Times; AURA has not checked court records.

cards.headline: FG vows National Library project completion in 24 months
cards.what_happened: The Federal Government, through Minister of Education Tunji Alausa, has pledged to complete the long-abandoned National Library of Nigeria headquarters project in Abuja within 24 months. The commitment was made publicly, though the article excerpt provided does not give contractor or cost details. The project is a public works undertaking of the Federal Ministry of Education.
key_facts: Tunji Alausa is the Minister of Education.
The National Library of Nigeria headquarters project in Abuja had been long abandoned.

cards.headline: FG scraps NTI’s university affiliations nationwide

cards.headline: Jigawa, Islamic Development Bank collaborate on $110m project to improve schools, teacher development
cards.what_happened: Jigawa State has collaborated with the Islamic Development Bank on a $110 million project aimed at improving schools and teacher development. The announcement was reported by Premium Times Nigeria.
analysis: Why it matters: A $110 million development financing project involving a state government and a multilateral lender affects public money management and the contractors who may later be engaged, though the available text gives no contractor or ownership details.
